source_version: Official SIGMA 7 (2011) article 021, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2011.021; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
license_fact: Named authors retain copyright; SIGMA publishes their papers under CC BY 4.0. The retained native journal source corresponds to the official DOI and PDF.
changes: Standalone excerpt wrapper, attribution, selected task scope and editorial notices added.
Theorem and section positions restored at boundaries; displayed equations use internally consistent excerpt numbering.
Cited bibliography entries retained under original reference numbers.

The unavailable dsfont alphabet is supplied by the standard blackboard-bold mathbb alphabet for R, Q, Z, C and N. Unused private legacy font declarations are omitted, and upper-Greek aliases are expanded dynamically to preserve their symbols with portable fonts. Original author prose and formulas are unchanged.
The legacy Log macro uses operatorname for its upright logarithm name, keeping its Gamma argument in math mode and preventing the legacy font switch from dropping that symbol.
